title: Judicial Structures and Procedural Rules for IP Disputes: A Comparative Report
content: Drawing on the law and practice of eleven jurisdictions, this report provides an overview of judicial structural options, the types and roles of judges and court-appointed experts, IP specific procedures, and related policy considerations. The report offers objective, practical insights to support policymakers and judiciaries considering reform of IP dispute resolution systems.
